actors.name: C03_01_Broker
actors.text: Ships are easy to lie about. Dates are harder. The warehouse clerks keep copies.

actors.name: C03_01_Survivor
actors.text: The younger Harlow was alive when they moved him. He watched every turn out of the harbor.

actors.body: Transfer: Harlow, Ethan. Alive. Navigation detail retained aboard Armada tender Asterion.
